name: Kouyoku Senki ExS-Tia Concerto 1
original_name: 光翼戦姫エクスティアコンチェルト1
source:
◆Faith will be your strength

In the peaceful city of Kawado Higashi, a fearsome discovery has been made—”Guilt Seeds” that cause people’s desires to run wild, turning them into monsters.
Left unchecked, countless innocents will be transformed into abominations, wreaking havoc upon others.
In order to prevent this from happening, Ichika Itakano must search for these Guilt Seeds.

During this time, Haruno Aikawa is attacked by one such Guilt Seed monster.
Coming across her by chance, Ichika sees that she has a talent for PP and bestows her with an ExS-Device.
The girl named Haruno transforms into ExS-TIA Ignis, and successfully defeats the monster.

At Ichika’s request, Haruno—newly christened “ExS-TIA Ignis”—aids her in her hunt for the Guilt Seeds.

[From [url=https://denpasoft.com/product/holy-valkyrie-exs-tia-concerto-1/]denpasoft[/url]]
translation:
◆信念将是你的力量

在宁静的河户东市，人们发现了令人恐惧的东西——“罪恶的种子”，它会导致人们的欲望失控，变成怪物。
如果不加以控制，无数无辜者将变成可憎之物，给他人造成严重破坏。
为了防止这种情况发生，板野一花必须寻找这些罪恶种子。

在此期间，春野·相川受到了一只罪孽种子怪物的攻击。
一香偶然遇见了她，发现她有PP天赋，并赠予她一台ExS装置。
名叫春野的女孩变身为ExS-TIA伊格尼斯，并成功击败了怪物。

应一花的请求，春野（新命名为“ExS-TIA伊格尼斯”）帮助她寻找罪恶之种。
